question: How might one obtain enjoyment from a mantra despite disregarding its wealth-giving aspect?
premises: One may disregard the wealth-giving aspect in the mantra.
Even so, one may obtain enjoyment.
inference: Mantra results can manifest as enjoyment even when its prosperity aspect is neglected.
uncertainties: The subject of avāptavān is implied from context.
plain_english: Having disregarded the wealth-giving aspect in the mantra, one has obtained enjoyment.
